+"""Parse date values: comma-separated items in brackets."""
+
+try:
+    import dotenv  # noqa: F401
+except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
+    dotenv = None
+
+from lamina.errors import ParseError
+
+
+def parse_date_value(raw: str, line: int, column: int, *, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> list[str]:
+    """Parse a [a, b, c] date value into its items."""
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(raw)
+    stripped_text = raw.strip()
+    if not (stripped_text.startswith("[") and stripped_text.endswith("]")):
+        raise ParseError(f"expected [items], got {raw!r}", line, column)
+    inner = stripped_text[1:-1].strip()
+    if not inner:
+        return []
+    items = [part.strip() for part in inner.split(",")]
+    if any(item == "" for item in items):
+        raise ParseError("empty item in list", line, column)
+    return items

+import pytest
+
+from lamina.parser.date import parse_date_value
+
+
+def test_date_items():
+    assert parse_date_value("[a, b]", 1, 1) == ["a", "b"]
+
+
+def test_date_empty_list():
+    assert parse_date_value("[]", 1, 1) == []
+

+def test_date_rejects_bare_value():
+    with pytest.raises(Exception):
+        parse_date_value("a, b", 2, 5)
